messages:
ravi: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A  three partner-influenced opportunities were flagged as timing risks. Can each owner drop a one-line status + the single next action for exec triage? I'll watch for 20m.

kait: Sales snapshot (very short):
- Solarity: $380k ARR, blocker = SOC2 proof + CISO sync. Next action: send SOC pack + request 30m sync. Owner: kait.
- VaultGrid (via partner RelayOne): $210k ARR, blocker = partner POC backlog and reseller margin language. Next action: offer 48h engineering wedge + draft credit. Owner: oliver.
- BeaconPay (renewal): $95k ARR, blocker = PO delay. Next action: send procurement packet + procurement intro. Owner: meera.

oliver: RelayOne wants a named contact and a checklist before allocating POC resources. If leadership approves the 48h wedge, I'll coordinate the partner and post engineer name.

meera: Legal/ops: I can produce procurement + credit templates today and attach SOC artifact templates for Kait. ETA: EOD.

notifier-bot: Calendar event created: "Pipeline triage - Solarity/VaultGrid/BeaconPay"  30m standup tomorrow 09:00 PST. Invitees: ravi, kait, oliver, meera. Link: https://calendar.internal/evt/2167000000

ravi: Thanks  decision needed: approve wedge + reorder sprint for revenue-protection or keep roadmap. If any deal >$250k mark high.

kait: Marking Solarity high ($380k). I'll escalate if SOC pack isn't out today.

oliver: If wedge approved, RelayOne confirmed they'll prioritize POC. I'll post confirmation and engineer by EOD.

meera: Posted templates: https://docs.internal/gtm/2167000000. Please review and tag me for sign-off.

ravi: OK closing  we'll review priorities in the rescue standup. If anything changes beforehand, update this thread."
